feature: DOM exporter and reusable interactive view
checks: Normal, offline editor and standalone DOM example builds
coverage: on/off/once, reentrant once and listener failure isolation
Read-only event payloads and source/target identities
Stable connection selection/state after array reorder
Runtime state/value updates independent of static export
Atomic layout validation and markup/attribute safety
Pan/click distinction, zoom, keyboard focus reveal
Multiple independent views and idempotent destroy
Narrow accessibility and file:// offline startup
limitations: Port-value badges do not participate in layout and may overlap in dense graphs
Domain-specific register forms, simulation and hardware access belong to the host application
